title: Flatness of E∞-ring maps and flatness of their spectra
statement_scope: Whole Proposition 1.5.11: let φ: A → B be a map of E∞-rings. The following conditions are equivalent: (1) the map φ is flat; (2) the induced map Spec B → Spec A is a flat morphism of nonconnective spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks.

standard_prerequisites: Definition 1.5.9 of a flat morphism of nonconnective spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks (author PDF p. 25).

Theorem 1.2.1: étale maps of E∞-rings correspond to étale maps of affine nonconnective spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks (author PDF p. 11).
Basic stability of flatness under base change and composition.
difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: H2 because the proof at author PDF p. 25 is a concrete equivalence argument, not a bare citation: from ring flatness it checks the defining flatness condition on an arbitrary étale commutative square by applying Theorem 1.2.1 to make B → B′ étale, using flatness of B over A and Lemma 1.5.10 to conclude B′ flat over A′; the converse is immediate. This is non-routine local flatness material, but a supporting equivalence rather than an H3 main construction.
